children: Overview
Hong Kong data centre operator's FY revenue rose 6% on strong demand for AI workloads
Profit attributable to shareholders increased 17%, aided by lower borrowing costs
Company accelerated MEGA IDC expansion to meet high occupancy and customer commitments
Outlook
Company expects robust demand for high-density, AI-related data centre capacity in Hong Kong
Sunevision is accelerating MEGA IDC Phase Two build-out, targeting completion in 2028
Company says it will maintain disciplined capital allocation and prioritize long-term value creation
Result Drivers
AI-DRIVEN DEMAND - Co said strong demand for premium data centre infrastructure was fuelled by hyperscale customers seeking large-scale AI deployments
NEW FACILITIES & ORGANIC GROWTH - Recurring revenue grew due to contributions from newly commissioned facilities and sustained organic growth from established portfolio
LOWER BORROWING COSTS - Earnings growth was aided by reduced finance costs from a more favourable interest rate environment
